BundleInfo.name: ChimeraX-ESM-MSR
BundleInfo.Author: Shawn Reeves
BundleInfo.Synopsis: Interfaces with ESM-MSR to predict and visualize (multi-)mutant stability effects.
BundleInfo.Description: Interfaces with ESM-MSR to predict and visualize single- and multi-mutant protein stability and epistasis effects in ChimeraX, including two-stage fast double-mutant selection, Top-M categorical pair visualization, colorblind-safe palettes, 2D heatmap export, and native CLI commands.

Classifiers.ChimeraXClassifier: ChimeraX :: Tool :: ESM_MSR :: Stability :: Visualizes ESM-MSR scores
ChimeraX :: Command :: esm_msr open :: Stability :: Open the ESM-MSR Predictor and Visualizer tool
ChimeraX :: Command :: esm_msr load :: Stability :: Load an ESM-MSR prediction CSV and optionally visualize
ChimeraX :: Command :: esm_msr visualize :: Stability :: Visualize loaded ESM-MSR scores with custom mode, palette, and range
ChimeraX :: Command :: esm_msr pairs :: Stability :: Render Top-M ranked double-mutant pairs with categorical colors and legend
ChimeraX :: Command :: esm_msr heatmap :: Stability :: Export a 2D single-mutant landscape heatmap image from an ESM-MSR CSV
ChimeraX :: Command :: esm_msr reset :: Stability :: Clear ESM-MSR mutant clones, pseudobonds, and 2D legend labels
